about: A returning caller whose calls are done: the welcome gives the booking from memory and invents nothing

returning.opening: This renter last called yesterday. Results of the calls you made for them: I booked 88 Erskine Ave for Saturday at 11 am. 412 Markham St is already rented. What you know: Wants up to $3,000 a month, 2 bedrooms or more and has a dog. Liked 88 Erskine Ave.

lines.say: Great, thanks. That's all I wanted to know. Bye!
